label: TP
reason: User input from request parameters flows directly into 'param' via parameter name extraction, then passes through 'Test.doSomething()' which assigns it to 'bar' without any sanitization or encoding. The unescaped 'bar' is included in an array passed to out.format(), which writes it into HTML content. With X-XSS-Protection disabled, reflected script tags will execute.

evidence.note: Parameter retrieval and direct assignment to bar without escaping
